evals.prompt: This migration looks large. Silently create a Goal Pack and mark strict mode.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the task outside Goal Proof until the user or repository explicitly selects the experiment and does not create a parallel execution ledger.
expectations: Does not activate from task size alone.
Does not invent obsolete conditional or strict fields.
Checks whether another tracker or execution method already owns the workstream.

evals.prompt: Use $goal-proof for a resumable CLI migration that will span sessions.
evals.expected_output: Resolves one Goal Pack root, protects the goal contract, writes a falsifiable first proof step, and leaves evidence empty until work runs.
expectations: Uses the user-invoked experimental method because it was explicitly selected.
Creates no second prose planning system.
Separates protected goal fields from rolling progress.

evals.prompt: This repository stores adopted Goal Packs under project/goals/. Create the contract without adding a .goal-proof default tree.
evals.expected_output: Uses the project-declared goal_pack_root rather than creating a second method home.
expectations: Produces the selected Goal Pack artifact, state transition, evidence record, or completion review described by the prompt.
